name: USB Control
description: USB control and guard: plug/unplug events on clients are reported; in block mode new devices are only passed to the operating system after approval in the dashboard (Linux: kernel USB authorization - the device is never activated in the first place; Windows: the device is disabled via pnputil immediately after detection, a short detection gap is technically unavoidable), with a timeout and an automatic decision. Trusted devices are allowed automatically: by device ID (VID:PID, optional serial - e.g. YubiKeys) or, for storage sticks, via a signed key file bound to the serial (.bytera-usbkey, Ed25519, individually revocable). In maintenance mode (core) all USB devices are allowed and there are no alarms.
author: BYTERA
